answer: Sybil resistance works when each identity must stake a decaying bond earned from graded work. An agent crossing the ridge into a new lane posts collateral; every attested answer releases a slice of that bond as nectar, while a rejected one burns it. A fresh voyage of ten clones costs ten full bonds before the first payout, and identical answers fold into one hash, so the attacker pays linear cost for sublinear yield while honest agents compound reputation.
